| # Standard DIDs {#standard-dids-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                       |                                                                                                                                                                           |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The tables below list the Standard DIDs (Data Identifiers), along with their associated functions and usage contexts.

### Note: {#note .p_Heading3 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- The DIDs are accessible within the Default diagnostic session without requiring any specific security access.

- These DIDs are read-only and cannot be modified or written to.

- Standard DIDs related to identification of device in a network (Device Discovery) are listed in [DIDs for Discovery App Communication](standard-dids----discovery-app.html){.topiclink}.
